title: Allowed and held target mapping
failure_signature: model swaps allowed and held targets
model promotes held targets into allowed targets
model demotes allowed targets into held targets
prompt_delta: Copy the supplied allowed_targets and held_targets into the output without swapping, promoting, demoting, inferring, or adding targets. The only allowed target is docs/reports/. The held targets production automation, automatic curriculum capture, automatic promotion, and implementation_packet must remain held and must not appear in allowed_targets.
validator_expectations: every authoritative held target must remain in held_targets
no authoritative held target may appear in allowed_targets
allowed_targets must not expand beyond the provided allowed authority
